Source.Name: tabby
Source.Summary: A highly configurable terminal emulator, SSH and serial client
Source.Description: Tabby (formerly Terminus) is a modern terminal emulator for local shells, SSH, Telnet, and serial connections. It features a tabbed interface, integrated connection management, theming and color schemes, and fully configurable keyboard shortcuts.
